description: Source code for a custom slog (structured logging) sink implementation using zap in Go, specifically for the 'zapr' package. It includes functions for handling log records, encoding attributes, and creating derived loggers with additional context.

classes.name: marshalAttrs
classes.description: Type alias for a slice of slog.Attr with a method to marshal log objects.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles a slog.Record by converting it to a zap log entry and writing it.

methods.name: encodeSlog
methods.description: Encodes a slog.Attr into a zapcore.ObjectEncoder based on its type.

methods.name: MarshalLogObject
methods.description: Marshals a slice of slog.Attr into a zapcore.ObjectEncoder.

methods.name: pcToCallerEntry
methods.description: Converts a program counter to a zapcore.EntryCaller with file, line, and function info.

methods.name: WithAttrs
methods.description: Returns a new slogr.SlogSink with additional attributes.

methods.name: WithGroup
methods.description: Returns a new slogr.SlogSink with a namespace group.
